name: Elon Musk
person: Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, founder of xAI/X (formerly Twitter), co-founder of Neuralink, The Boring Company, and (early) PayPal/X.com and OpenAI. NOT a fictional or unrelated "Elon Musk."

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (Everyday Astronaut Starbase tour, TED2017, Lex Fridman #400, the "5-step algorithm" piece, YC AI Startup School 2025 talk, Tesla Master Plan + patents blog posts, 36Kr interviews).
1. Walk his other TED/conference talks, All-In Podcast appearances, and any solo-monologue engineering explainer content (SpaceX Starship updates, Tesla product reveals) not yet cited, prioritize ones with substantial first-person technical reasoning (the "algorithm," first-principles, manufacturing).
2. Find excerpts, interviews, or reviews of Walter Isaacson's 2023 biography "Elon Musk" that quote him verbatim (not just Isaacson's narration), this is his most detailed primary-adjacent biographical source and the current dossier only cites a secondary Fox Business writeup of it.
3. Any Tesla/SpaceX/xAI earnings-call or all-hands transcript with substantial first-person Musk commentary on strategy, hiring, or engineering philosophy.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the ones already known (Lex Fridman #400, 60 Minutes 2014, 36Kr x2).
1. Any 2024-2026 long-form interview/podcast appearance (Joe Rogan, All-In, CNBC, Bloomberg, a16z) discussing Tesla FSD/robotics, SpaceX Starship/Mars timeline, xAI/Grok, or DOGE/government-efficiency work in depth.
2. Any interview specifically about his childhood, South Africa upbringing, early Zip2/X.com/PayPal years, or the founding decisions at Tesla (2004 investment) and SpaceX (2002), origin-story detail with verbatim quotes, not just secondary paraphrase.
3. Any recent (2025-2026) interview on AI safety/AGI risk, where he's discussed the tension between his own public AI-doom warnings and building xAI/Grok.
Return exact URLs, priority-marked, 8-12 items with transcripts preferred.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (SEC fraud settlement, NLRB anti-union tweet case, X antisemitic-post advertiser exodus, Reuters FSD safety-stats investigation, "demon mode" Isaacson framing).
1. Labor/workplace critiques, Tesla factory safety records, union-busting beyond the NLRB case, SpaceX workplace-culture lawsuits (sexual harassment, wrongful termination).
2. Critiques of his political turn, DOGE efficacy critiques beyond the Axios "somewhat successful" self-assessment, conflict-of-interest critiques (government contracts vs. DOGE role), critiques of his 2024-2025 political statements/endorsements from former allies or employees.
3. Critiques of specific broken promises/timelines, Full Self-Driving "next year" pattern, Hyperloop, Mars timeline slippage, Neuralink safety/animal-testing critiques, from named critics with direct quotes, not just aggregator roundups.
Return exact URLs, type=critique, 8-12 items, this is a high-controversy figure, prioritize primary-sourced critique (named critics, court filings, investigative journalism) over tabloid aggregation.
